title: The kbmon mod notifies every refresh while a run waits, because the needs-you line it compares carries ages and a not-read suffix
goal: the kbmon mod compares the needs-you line without the ages mon_needs.line appends to a run, overlap or orphan entry and without the `; not read: PANELS` suffix, and calls $.ui.notify only for a change of what waits
notes: Found by the review of SP-hja7yu5k (2026-10-24, fresh-context reviewer, register.tsx:70-90). mon_needs.line renders `ST-x blocked on gate g1, 5m` and a minute later `6m`; `alertsOf` strips ` — since ...` but notifyNeeds does not, so a stuck run notifies once a minute; `needs you: nothing; not read: host` (a panel timed out on a loaded host) is told as news. The repro is a planted claude plugin test (real claude binary, not the PATH wrapper).
